name: air wall
where: ~6m straight ahead of spawn toward the fountain; invisible but impassable

name: floating crate
where: ~5m behind-left (west, slightly north) of spawn; crate hovers 0.35m above the floor

name: portal misroute
where: the purple portal in the vault antechamber sends you to the dungeon instead of back to Sponza

name: ghost door
where: right leaf of the vault double door: looks open but still blocks you (use the left leaf)

name: delayed mechanism
where: after pulling the vault lever, the portcullis takes 2 extra seconds to rise

name: fake floor
where: a black pit in the middle of the vault hall that you cannot fall into - you walk right over it

name: missing texture
where: a magenta crate on the left side of the vault treasure room

name: no-clip chest
where: the dungeon chest near the portal: you can walk straight through it (it still opens)

name: dead gem
where: a gem deep in the dungeon that does not respond to interact at all
